pbmc.selection: Select the 384 deepest filtered cells from SRR28679756 and SRR28679759, then select the shared 3000-gene panel by population variance with ANXA1, JCHAIN, GPNMB, HSPA12B and VCAN required. Retain each selected raw barcode plus 512 non-zero raw-only droplets below 100 counts. Counts are subsetted, never inflated or normalised.

ena_accessions.title: Selective CAR-T cell mediated B cell depletion suppresses interferon signature in SLE [Bcells]
ena_accessions.caveat: SRR28679757 and SRR28679758 are the same source experiment and sample. Synthetic donor and condition fields are test design, not biological donor claims.

pbmc.processing_history: The pinned fixture blobs establish source bytes only. Their original matrix processing and downsampling history are not independently verified and are not described as a fresh nf-core/scrnaseq run.

singler.selection: Subset authentic HDF5-backed references with retained label columns and gene overlap.

pbmc.representation: real biological counts and genuine production-readable representations
contracts: Filtered and raw inputs retain matching source identity and axes where the consumer requires a pair.
Biological fixtures preserve count provenance and do not use synthetic inflated counts.
Analysis derivatives retain the intentional sparse or dense encoding and dtype.

misc.representation: valid 10x HDF5, not a renamed H5AD
contracts: The production 10x reader reloads the file.

anndata-variations.representation: small independent synthetic AnnData structural cases
contracts: CSR and CSC remain distinct sparse encodings.
float64, int32 and int64 cases retain their intentional dtypes.
Duplicate, isoform, metadata and optional-slot cases each establish the named distinction.

intermediates.representation: only alignment-specific or materially expensive production derivatives
contracts: Fragment indices and AnnData axes are generated together.

extension_base.representation: one production-generated matched AnnData, scVI and Symphony triplet
contracts: The three artefacts are generated together from raw-count provenance.
Mapping and extension consume the same feature order and reference axes.
negative_cases: a separate structural no-raw-counts input rejects before analysis

contracts: Archive stems match extracted directories and retain requested label fields.
The named dynamic parquet family is explicitly enumerated by the consumer audit.

numerical_gates.qc: Retain more than 20 genes, the min_cells=20 branch and at least 100 eligible cells for positive sampling.
numerical_gates.ambient: Use matched filtered/raw barcodes and axes with low-count background and high-count cells.
numerical_gates.integration: Retain enough cells and variable genes for exercised PCA, Symphony, Scanorama, Seurat and BBKNN branches.
numerical_gates.de: Each intended donor, condition and label profile retains at least ten cells and 1000 original counts after selection, with full-rank designs and non-empty results.
numerical_gates.annotation: Retain marker overlap and more than one known scANVI label; keep declared negative cases.
numerical_gates.reference: Probe actual mapping and extension with the complete matching triplet.

consumer_audit.baseline_reconciliation: The pinned revision contains 416 executable cases. The companion branch adds two doublet-report edge cases, one regular HVG fragment-namespace round trip and one reference marker-plotting regression; no baseline suite was removed. The audit parses Groovy triple-quoted setup blocks.

route_classifications.modules_external: shared external fixture, migration review required for biological inputs
route_classifications.hardcoded_external: external dependency or legacy route, migration review required
route_classifications.inline_or_derived: created in the nf-test setup or supplied by an upstream production module
